text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer 
Training Camp" to boost abilities. The 
days of dedicating oneself to intensive 
training begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—...Or so it seemed, but on the other 
hand, Hishi Akebono appeared to have 
shrewdly planned some fun, like watermelon 
splitting and flowing somen noodles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll make sure to train hard, too. 
Exchanging that promise, our hot summer 
training camp began!
